name: South Australia

known.via: English Wikipedia "South Australia (wine)" (redirects to "South Australian wine")

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

notes: South Australia runs from lime-scented Clare Valley Riesling to full bodied Barossa Shiraz.
Clare and Eden Valley Riesling often shows a lime note.

blurb.text: The state that makes about half of all Australian wine. Its range runs from Riesling in Clare Valley to big, full-bodied Shiraz in Barossa Valley.
